listedCourseDetails: Seasonal Omakase - Choose Your Soba - Includes 1 Glass of Champagne *Drink Change Available — JPY 16,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 8. This month's omakase course features dishes incorporating fermentation and koji elements, allowing you to enjoy our signature handmade soba throughout the meal. To finish off, you can choose one dish of soba according to your preference. The course includes a complimentary drink, with options available for non-alcoholic beverages as well. We invite you to indulge in the entire experience, including dessert.

Seasonal Omakase - Choose Your Clay Pot Rice - Includes 1 Glass of Champagne *Drink Change Available — JPY 19,800 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 8. This month's omakase course features dishes centered around fermentation and koji, seamlessly incorporating our signature handmade soba into the flow of the meal. For the main dish, enjoy Akita Kogen Hinai Chicken, and to finish off, choose from a selection of clay pot rice (available for takeout). The course includes a complimentary first drink and you can indulge in dessert as well.

Seasonal Omakase - Ladies' Night Course — JPY 12,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 8. This month’s omakase course features dishes centered around fermentation and koji, complemented by our signature handmade soba throughout the course. Enjoy a glass of sparkling wine to start, with the option to switch to other drinks. The menu is designed to be enjoyable even for those who prefer non-alcoholic options. Please indulge in the dessert as well. Please note that this is a Ladies' Night course. Enjoy a delightful time with your friends at your girls' party!

Hokkaido-Style Jingisukan at Hitsuji to Meshi, Tokyo

Bringing Hokkaido’s flavors to Tokyo, Hitsuji to Meshi is run by three chefs trained at the renowned “Sumibi Kabuto Hitsuji.” Featuring mainly Hokkaido lamb and carefully selected Australian lamb, the restaurant brings out the meat’s rich, natural flavor with remarkably little gamey aroma. Enjoy Hokkaido-style Jingisukan paired with Korean cuisine, and discover a new way to enjoy lamb in Tokyo.

capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.

capabilities.name: END_READ
capabilities.purpose: End a bounded read-only investigation when its recorded scope has no grounded result to present.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes a scoped NO_VERIFIED_RESULT outcome from authoritative investigation records, never a global negative claim.

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS

capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

Seasonal Omakase - Choose Your Soba - Includes 1 Glass of Champagne *Drink Change Available

This month's omakase course features dishes incorporating fermentation and koji elements, allowing you to enjoy our signature handmade soba throughout the meal. To finish off, you can choose one dish of soba according to your preference. The course includes a complimentary drink, with options available for non-alcoholic beverages as well. We invite you to indulge in the entire experience, including dessert.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY16,000（Price including tax）per person
Number of people
2 - 8

Seasonal Omakase - Choose Your Clay Pot Rice - Includes 1 Glass of Champagne *Drink Change Available

This month's omakase course features dishes centered around fermentation and koji, seamlessly incorporating our signature handmade soba into the flow of the meal. For the main dish, enjoy Akita Kogen Hinai Chicken, and to finish off, choose from a selection of clay pot rice (available for takeout). The course includes a complimentary first drink and you can indulge in dessert as well.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY19,800（Price including tax）per person
Number of people
2 - 8

Seasonal Omakase - Ladies' Night Course

This month’s omakase course features dishes centered around fermentation and koji, complemented by our signature handmade soba throughout the course. Enjoy a glass of sparkling wine to start, with the option to switch to other drinks. The menu is designed to be enjoyable even for those who prefer non-alcoholic options. Please indulge in the dessert as well. Please note that this is a Ladies' Night course. Enjoy a delightful time with your friends at your girls' party!

ReserveSet menu details
JPY12,000（Price including tax）per person
Number of people
2 - 8

listedCourseDetails: Seasonal Omakase - Choose Your Soba - Includes 1 Glass of Champagne *Drink Change Available — JPY 16,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 8. This month's omakase course features dishes incorporating fermentation and koji elements, allowing you to enjoy our signature handmade soba throughout the meal. To finish off, you can choose one dish of soba according to your preference. The course includes a complimentary drink, with options available for non-alcoholic beverages as well. We invite you to indulge in the entire experience, including dessert.

Seasonal Omakase - Choose Your Clay Pot Rice - Includes 1 Glass of Champagne *Drink Change Available — JPY 19,800 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 8. This month's omakase course features dishes centered around fermentation and koji, seamlessly incorporating our signature handmade soba into the flow of the meal. For the main dish, enjoy Akita Kogen Hinai Chicken, and to finish off, choose from a selection of clay pot rice (available for takeout). The course includes a complimentary first drink and you can indulge in dessert as well.

Seasonal Omakase - Ladies' Night Course — JPY 12,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 8. This month’s omakase course features dishes centered around fermentation and koji, complemented by our signature handmade soba throughout the course. Enjoy a glass of sparkling wine to start, with the option to switch to other drinks. The menu is designed to be enjoyable even for those who prefer non-alcoholic options. Please indulge in the dessert as well. Please note that this is a Ladies' Night course. Enjoy a delightful time with your friends at your girls' party!
